{{Move|Shiny Celebi (Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky)|article}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Psychic| type2=Grass| shiny=yes | ball=None| nickname=Celebi| jnickname=セレビィ| tmnickname=Celebi| image=[[File:251Celebi Shiny PMD Explorers.png|220px]] | caught=no | caption=Celebi {{shinystar|IV}}| gender={{tt|Female|Although referred to as such in the games, Celebi is still usually gender unknown for gameplay purposes.}} | ability={{a|Natural Cure}} | pokemonname=Celebi| location=Not caught| prevonum=251 s| noevo=incap | epnum=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness| current=In the future | media=game | va=no| }} '''Celebi''' (Japanese: '''セレビィ''' ''Celebi'') is a [[Shiny Pokémon]] that appears in {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness}} and {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky}}, as well as {{g|Super Mystery Dungeon}} and {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX}}. Like all Celebi, this one is treated as gender unknown for gameplay purposes; however, it is addressed with feminine pronouns in dialogue. Shiny Celebi is impossible to permanently recruit through legitimate means in Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky. It has the same stats and moves as the regular Celebi, however. ==In the games== ===History=== ====[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness|Explorers of Time, Darkness]], and [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky|Sky]]==== {{spoilers}} Celebi is seen in the future, where she originally helped {{mdc|Grovyle|2}} escape to the present to collect [[Time Gear]]s. Celebi can [[Time travel|travel short distances through time]] all by herself, but for big trips of many generations, she uses the Passage of Time at the end of [[Deep Dusk Forest]]. She does not like the everlasting darkness of the future, and is willing to sacrifice herself to get rid of the planet's paralysis. When the {{pkmn2|hero}} and [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] are trapped in the future with Grovyle, Celebi guides them, by joining their team, through Deep Dusk Forest to the Passage of Time, where they can escape to the present again. When they make it there they are cut off by {{mdc|Dusknoir|2}} and his {{p|Sableye}}, as well as [[Primal Dialga]]. Primal Dialga interferes with Celebi's time traveling, but thanks to the partner's quick thinking, she is able to teleport them forwards in time just past Dusknoir and his Sableye and close enough to the Passage of Time to escape. She repeatedly claims it's impossible for Dusknoir to catch her and this seems to hold true, as it appears she escapes Dusknoir after helping the hero, partner, and Grovyle go back in time. =====[[In the Future of Darkness]]===== In the [[In the Future of Darkness]] special episode, Celebi reappears as a prisoner of {{p|Spiritomb}} at the end of the [[Icicle Forest]], used by Dusknoir to bait Grovyle into standing in between the four electricity-generating pillars of ice to literally melt away Grovyle's spirit. Dusknoir would then occupy Grovyle's body and return to the past; however, he gives up on the ploy right as Grovyle's spirit was almost completely melted away. Out of nowhere, Primal Dialga then appears, and attacks everyone except Celebi and Spiritomb; however, it is after this time that the long-paralyzed planet finally starts moving again, as pointed out by Celebi by breezing winds and, most notably, an aurora. After being saved by Grovyle and Dusknoir, they chase the berserk Primal Dialga to the top of [[Vast Ice Mountain]], where she helps in the successful effort to take it down. Afterwards, she, Grovyle, Dusknoir, Sableye, Dialga, and the other Pokémon of the future are spared of being erased from history, presumably by {{p|Arceus}}. {{endspoilers}} ===={{g|Super Mystery Dungeon}}==== Celebi reappears as a character that needs to be rescued in Super Mystery Dungeon through Grovyle's request. Rescuing Celebi will allow her and Grovyle to be used as playable characters. Upon being rescued, it is revealed to the player that she fainted on purpose just so that Grovyle would come to save her and is disappointed that he didn't come alone. ===={{g|Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX}}==== Celebi appears during the post-game. After beating [[Purity Forest]] for the first time, a Shiny Celebi has a rare chance to appear in Mystery Houses, likely as a reference to the Celebi from Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky. If a Shiny Celebi is encountered, simply talking to her will recruit her into the player's team. Celebi is the only Shiny Pokémon to not be encountered as a {{DL|Mystery Dungeon|Strong Foes|Strong Foe}}. ===Personality and characteristics=== Apparently, Celebi has feelings for Grovyle, which are shown when the hero and the partner are trapped in the future, even blushing when the hero talks to her. Right before they both vanish in the morning sun after defeating Primal Dialga at the Vast Ice Mountain Peak, Grovyle holds Celebi in his arms as they watch the future's first sunrise, with Celebi commenting that she had never seen such a beautiful sight before. ===Moves used=== {{incomplete|section|Default level in SMD}} {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon | caption = '''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness|Explorers of Time, Darkness]], and [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky|Sky]]''' | gen = 4 | ndex = 0251 | pokemon = Celebi | image = HOME251 s.png | gender = none | shiny = yes | level = 45{{tt|+|Celebi may level up over the course of the special episode}} | type1 = Psychic | type2 = Grass | ability = Natural Cure | move1 = Magical Leaf | move1type = Grass | move1cat = Special | move2 = Recover | move2type = Normal | move2cat = Status | move3 = Heal Bell | move3type = Normal | move3cat = Status | move4 = AncientPower | move4type = Rock | move4cat = Special }} {{Pokémon | caption = '''{{pkmn|Super Mystery Dungeon}}''' | gen = 6 | ndex = 0251 | pokemon = Celebi | image = MDP 3DS 251 s.png | gender = none | shiny = yes | level = ?? {{color2|000|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness|Explorers of Time, Darkness}} and {{color2|000|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky|Sky}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Celebi BET.png|thumb|180px|Celebi in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team]] ===Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team=== Celebi appeared in [[BET3]]. {{sectionstub}} {{-}} ==Trivia== *Celebi is the second [[Shiny Pokémon]] to have a major role in a story; the first was the [[red Gyarados]] when it appeared in [[Generation II]]. **Celebi is also the first Shiny Pokémon to appear in the {{pkmn|Mystery Dungeon series}}, predating the ability to find (and recruit) such alternately-colored Pokémon in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon (WiiWare)|the three Pokémon Mystery Dungeon WiiWare games]]. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Celebi}} {{MDcharacters|psychic|grass}} {{Project CharacterDex notice}} [[Category:Pokémon characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX characters]] [[Category:Shiny Pokémon]] [[Category:Female characters (Pokémon)]] [[de:Celebi (Pokémon Mystery Dungeon)]] [[fr:Celebi/Pokémon Donjon Mystère]] [[it:Celebi (Esploratori del Tempo, dell'Oscurità e del Cielo)]] [[zh:时拉比（时暗空探险队）]]
